q: If plants do not receive enough water, they ____.
e: সাধারণ সত্য বা বৈজ্ঞানিক নিয়ম বোঝাতে Zero Conditional ব্যবহৃত হয়, যার গঠন If + Present Indefinite + Present Indefinite। If-clause-এ do not receive আছে, তাই main clause-এও Present Indefinite হবে। Subject they বহুবচন, তাই verb-এর base form die বসে: If plants do not receive enough water, they die. Died অতীত কাল, dying অসম্পূর্ণ রূপ, আর would die সাধারণত অবাস্তব বা কাল্পনিক শর্তে আসে; তাই এগুলো খাটে না।

q: Which of the following sentences is correct?
o: The authority recommended that the employee given two days' leave.
The authority recommended that the employee should given two days' leave.
The authority recommended that the employee are given two day leave.
The authority recommended that the employee be given two days' leave.

q: If I had not intervened at the right moment, Jim ___ arrested.
e: If I had not intervened (Past Perfect) থাকায় এটি Type 3 conditional, তাই ফলে would/could/might + have + V3 বসে। জিম গ্রেফতার হতো, অর্থাৎ Passive: might have been arrested। অর্থ: আমি ঠিক সময়ে হস্তক্ষেপ না করলে জিমকে গ্রেফতার করা হতো। may have been আর can have been অতীতের অনুমানে বসে, কিন্তু শর্তের ফল হিসেবে সঠিক রূপ নয়। could have-এর পরে been না থাকায় Passive মেলে না।

q: If I had known Rifat was coming ___.
o: I would go to the station
I would have gone to the station
I had gone to the station
I would be going to the station
e: If I had known (Past Perfect) Type 3 conditional বোঝায়, তাই ফল অংশে would have + V3 বসে: I would have gone to the station। অর্থ: রিফাত আসছে জানলে আমি স্টেশনে যেতাম (কিন্তু জানতাম না, যাইনি)। I would go আর I would be going বর্তমান বা ভবিষ্যতের কথা বলে। I had gone শর্তের ফলের রূপ নয়, কারণ ফলে would লাগে।

q: Which of the following sentences is correct?
o: If she had come to the party, she could meet her old friends.
If she had came to the party, she could meet her old friends.
If she had came to the party, she could have met her old friends.
If she had come to the party, she could have met her old friends.

q: Had I studied harder, I ______ the exam.
She talks as though she _____ a child.
She sings as if she __________ a professional singer.
If they leave early, they ______ the train.
e: বাস্তবে ঘটতে পারে এমন ভবিষ্যৎ শর্তে First Conditional ব্যবহৃত হয়: If + Present Indefinite, subject + will + verb। If-clause-এ leave আছে, তাই main clause-এ will catch বসে। অর্থ: তারা তাড়াতাড়ি বের হলে ট্রেন ধরতে পারবে। Would catch দ্বিতীয় (কাল্পনিক) শর্তে আসে, caught অতীতকাল, আর would have caught অতীতের অপূর্ণ শর্তে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

q: Fill up the blank: If I were you, I ______ accept his apology.
If I _________ enough money, I would have gone to Japan.
If we had enough time, we ____ the whole movie.
If he were president, _______________________.
o: he would have prioritized education reform

q: Identify the First Conditional:
o: If he has time, he visits us next Friday.
If it snows tomorrow, schools will close.
If you need help, ask me.
If I had known, I would have helped.
e: বাস্তব ও সম্ভাব্য ভবিষ্যৎ পরিস্থিতি বোঝাতে First Conditional ব্যবহার হয়। গঠন: If + present simple, subject + will + base verb। তাই If it snows tomorrow, schools will close এর উদাহরণ। অন্যগুলো ভিন্ন: If he has time, he visits us সাধারণ সত্য বোঝায়, If you need help, ask me-তে imperative আছে, আর If I had known, I would have helped হলো Third Conditional।

q: If I had studied harder at college, I ______ to a better university.
Choose the correct sentence.
o: If I known his number, I would call him.
If I knew his number, I would call him.
If I knew his number, I would have call him.
If I knows his number, I would call him.

q: Identify the correct sentence:
o: The project would have been completed if more resources had allocated.
The project will be completed if more resources had been allocated.
The project would have been completed if more resources been allocated.
The project would have been completed if more resources had been allocated.

q: If the company _____ in modern equipment, it could increase its production.
e: If-clause-এ past indefinite থাকলে main clause-এ would/could/might + base verb বসে; এটি second conditional, যা বর্তমানের অবাস্তব বা কাল্পনিক শর্ত বোঝায়। Main clause-এ could increase থাকায় If-clause-এ past form invested বসে। অর্থ: কোম্পানি যদি আধুনিক যন্ত্রপাতিতে বিনিয়োগ করত, তাহলে উৎপাদন বাড়াতে পারত। Invests, will invest ও investing গঠনে মেলে না।

q: He talks as if he _________ the boss.
